rawLabelExplanation: The launcher uses a generic STOP file; the stop was not caused by reaching quota.
validEvidence: External host verifier executed pinned tests on candidate sources; those finite observations remain valid.
invalidInference: The agent-internal Unity feedback path was not proven. No Brain-vs-Codex conclusion or batch-2 eligibility decision is supported.
protocolDeviation: Missing native Unity execution receipts should have been classified as infrastructure in A. The >=2 A infrastructure stop was not enforced because the guard accepted tool completion metadata and host fallback masked the failure.
remediation: Require successful native tool result plus durable matching broker receipt; prohibit missing-receipt host fallback; local-only regression checks; no further model dispatch.

calibration.confounding: Includes root monitoring and possible other Codex activity; integer usage rounding. Descriptive only.
